description: A Streamlit-based web app for a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Q&A system, including UI setup, session management, and integration with vector store and OpenAI API for answering questions based on textbook chapters.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: Handles loading and searching vector embeddings for chapters.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: Manages embedding of text queries into vector space.

classes.name: AsyncOpenAI
classes.description: Asynchronous client for OpenAI API interactions.

methods.name: generate_rag_answer
methods.description: Generates an answer to a question using RAG approach by retrieving relevant chapter chunks and querying OpenAI.
